notes.title: Ringo’s Roundup is here!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to Ringo’s Roundup - [b]the game is now available on Steam and postbunny Ringo is ready for duty![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877272/f0e05605c181ad6d1d29d29a240ceab02383d6e0.jpg[/img]

Hope you’ll have fun driving through the colorful environments (ah to be a little travelling bunny), doing crazy puzzles (many with more than one solution!), and taking on challenging levels!

[b]Thank you everyone and may your mail deliveries be swift and puzzly ♥[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877272/bb9c369cf794020edbb241e02f96572d254c7658.png[/img]

notes.title: Ringo's Roundup Free Demo!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

The [b]Ringo's Roundup Demo[/b] is finally ready! 💌 
Download now and try it out for free! 🐰 

It has 22 levels, featuring some of the game's early mechanics.
There will of course be more in the full game, but this serves as a nice taste of things to come. 

Some features not included in the demo that you can look forward to in the full game:
[list]
[*] 100+ levels
[*] Several more mechanics like Magnets and Wormholes!
[*] Customization of Ringo's Car
[/list]If you want to help us improve the game, consider taking a minute to answer the Feedback Survey after playing the demo! 
(You'll find a button directing you there in the demo itself, or you can click [url=https://forms.gle/S8JAd9JynZ12hrUX7]here[/url])

We hope you enjoy your time with the demo, and hope to see you later in our Discord community!
[url=https://discord.gg/VasKmpG57B]Join our Discord![/url]

Remember to [b]Wishlist[/b] if you want to be notified when the full game is out!
